# assignmentB2EuniceLi

This is the package created strictly for assignmentB2 and is the pre-baked 
function which creates a new data frame with counts of the total number of missing 
values in each column optionally grouped by a user defined column.

## Installation

Install the package by running the following: 

``` r
devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2EuniceLi", ref = "0.1.0")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to use this function:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2EuniceLi)
## basic example code
countAll_missing_by_group(datasets::airquality,Wind)
countAll_missing_by_group(datasets::airquality,Day)
```
